title: MUX-S1: a pre-registered check of discrete switching in the data of Hesse et al. (2026)
description: Pre-registered study of the population dynamics behind the rapid alternation of conscious and suppressed stimulus representations reported by Hesse, Lanfranchi, McGrory, Shi, Engel and Tsao (bioRxiv 10.64898/2026.10.15.759299). Version 1.0 (18 October 2026): simulations of candidate latent dynamics and of the authors' analysis pipeline before the data release. Version 1.1 (pre-registered 21 October 2026, run 28 October 2026): the check of the 1.0 predictions against the released data (Zenodo record 23604909): reader of the released MATLAB files, frozen checks, primary, secondary and exploratory runs, deviation log and report. The four published archives with their SHA-256 hashes are included in archives/. Licensing: code is released under MIT; text, figures, results and digitized data are released under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The authors' data are not redistributed, except the face feature maps in mux_s1/feature_maps.npz (CC BY 4.0, credit Hesse et al. 2026), converted with values unchanged.
